title: Weak-model patch output contract (patch mode)
description: JSON counterpart of the markdown patch template checked by scripts/check_ai_protocol.py --mode patch. Each property is the line content of the corresponding markdown section, as an array of strings. Aligned checks: all five sections required; 'Files changed' must be non-empty (minItems 1); total lines must not exceed the patch budget of 10 (LINE_BUDGETS.patch) - enforced by checker code; a success claim without command evidence in verification content requires an explicit NOT VERIFIED entry (checker code); forbidden noise phrases rejected.

files_changed.description: Files changed: every touched path (never empty).

harness_checks.description: Harness checks: per-item PASS/FAIL against the selected harnesses.

verification_run.description: Verification run: commands actually executed with their result; a tool name must look like an invocation (e.g. 'python scripts/validate.py'), not a prose mention.

failures_not_verified.description: Failures / NOT VERIFIED: failures, or explicit 'NOT VERIFIED: <why>' entries.

residual_risks.description: Residual risks: what remains unproven after this patch.
